title: The ETH Believer Starter Pack
tagline: The ETH Believer Starter Pack is an automated strategy for accumulating wstETH and generating up to 25% yield on top of it in capital-efficient way with zero manual action We wish you a Happy HODL!
description:
The automated ETH HODL strategy offers a unique combination of high yield, safety and ease of use, and it is a perfect solution for ETH believers to enjoy the Arbitrum ecosystem empowered by the crypto-native automation.
We call it "Starter Pack" or "Happy HODL" for reasons! 
### What’s inside this pack?
- Automatic DCA strategy for ETH accumulation & wstETH purchase
- wstETH “Happy HODL” (Boosted mood) yield strategy with ~ 25% APY in wstETH
### You get the following features:
- Individual, transparent, on-chain, and automated in a decentralized way
- Built on Arbitrum - low cost of operation/can be afforded by ordinary users
- Protected from liquidation by on-chain automation
### Why Arbitrum?
Automatic smart-contracts execution is a powerful tool if works reliably and in decentralized way. However, to derive added value from it, we need:
 1. developed and liquid Defi ecosystem
 2. low fees (or multiple operations will be too costly)
 Arbitrum is a perfect match! That is why the starter pack is build on Arbitrum:
 - It’s much cheaper to run complex on-chain strategies on Arbitrum than on Ethereum
 - More yield for more users - the pack suits a much wider range of stake sizes
 - Individually-created automation Jobs - only you define what happens to your funds

how_its_made: The main challenge was to implement all the necessary interfaces required for interaction with multiple entities on-chain. This takes a lot of code and limits the flexibility and reusability of code, and is definitely a target for further improvements and adding abstraction layers.
